cohort: The study included all women who delivered at a major tertiary hospital in China between March 2012 and February 2022.
finding: The incidence of complete uterine rupture was 0.016%, with a prior uterine scar being the leading risk factor, and despite all mothers surviving, the perinatal mortality rate was high at 27.5%.
mod_finding: A prior uterine scar, primarily resulting from previous cesarean sections, was identified as the predominant risk factor for complete uterine rupture.
gest_age: Median gestational age at rupture was 36(+4) weeks (range, 13(+6)-40(+6))
